The '''Humbarine sector''', also known as '''Humbarine Rule''', was located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It contained the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-planet]] [[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]], one of the [[Core Founder/Legends|founding members]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and several [[Factory world/Legends|manufacturing worlds]], being one of the Republic's most industrialized and wealthy [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

During that conflict, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] carried out many devastating attacks on the sector's [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], including an [[Bombardment of Humbarine/Legends|orbital bombardment]] of Humbarine. The Republic's mismanagement caused heavy losses in the Humbarine sector, and it was eventually abandoned as a lost cause. After the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Humbarine system/Legends|Humbarine system]] was situated within the territory controlled by that government.

==Description==
The Humbarine [[Sector/Legends|sector]],<ref name="CSWE HumbarineSector">{{CSWECite|II|67|Humbarine sector}}</ref> alternatively known as Humbarine Rule, was a sterile region<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> of the [[Arrowhead]], which was itself [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA Humbarine" /> The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Trellen Trade Route/Legends|Trellen Trade Route]] passed through<ref name="TEA" /> the sector's<ref name="EAOC" /> Humbarine system, linking it to the [[Trellen system/Legends|Trellen system]] as well as the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']] [[Commenor system/Legends|Commenor system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
[[File:BarrowOicunn.png|thumb|right|300px|During the Clone Wars, Barrow Oicunn fought in the defense of the Humbarine sector.]]
In the [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] preceding the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="CV2016">[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'', 2016 edition]]</ref> the Humbarine sector was one of the wealthiest sectors of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> and among the most industrialized parts of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], in that aspect only being rivaled by the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian]] and [[Kuat sector/Legends|Kuat sectors]],<ref name="CSWE HumbarineSector" /> also situated in the Core.<ref name="EAOC" /> During that [[Time/Legends|time]], many larger and more powerful [[Warship/Legends|warships]] than the later 752-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] were constructed for the defense of the Humbarine sector, but those [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] were only equipped with local-range [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]]<ref name="CV2016" /> due to the regulations set forth by the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] of [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. Two [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] before the Clone Wars, [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] created the eight-[[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]]-long [[Mandator-class Star Dreadnaught|''Mandator''-class Star Dreadnaught]] for use in the Kuat [[Kuati Sector Forces|sector defense fleet]], and by the time of that conflict, the Humbarine sector had also acquired a [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|vessel]] of the class.<ref name="EGTW" />

[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bana Breemu/Legends|Bana Breemu]] represented the Humbarine sector in the Republic's [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the Clone Wars,<ref name="DB Breemu" /> and during the first campaigns of the conflict in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Republic's [[Second Army|Second Sector Army]] was tasked with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in vicinity of the Humbarine [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="EGTW" /> As an important area of the Republic, the Humbarine sector had the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of its [[Planetary Security Forces|local defense forces]] organized under the Republic's war council.<ref name="DB Oicunn">{{DB|character|ltoicunn|Oicunn, Lieutenant}}</ref>

Despite the inspired tactics of the Humbarine sector defense forces' junior [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Barrow Oicunn/Legends|Barrow Oicunn]], however,<ref name="DB Oicunn" /> Republic mismanagement led to heavy losses in the sector.<ref name="CSWE Oicunn">{{CSWECite|II|405|Oicunn, Lieutenant Barrow}}</ref> Some of the Humbarine sector's [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] joined the Confederacy, providing it with key industrial resources.<ref name="CSWE HumbarineSector">{{CSWECite|II|67|Humbarine sector}}</ref> Many others were infiltrated,<ref name="DB Breemu" /> conquered, or ravaged by the Confederate forces.<ref name="CSWE Breemu">{{CSWECite|I|93|Breemu, Bana}}</ref> The sector's [[Capital/Legends|capital]],<ref name="CSWE Humbarine" /> [[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]], came under repeated devastating attacks led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]],<ref name="DB Oicunn" /> which, in around [[20 BBY/Legends|20.2 BBY]],<ref name="BombardmentDate">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Battle of Duro (Clone Wars)|Battle of Duro]], which&mdash;along with the [[Bombardment of Humbarine/Legends|bombardment of Humbarine]]&mdash;is established by ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' to have been a part of [[Operation Durge's Lance]], to [[20 BBY/Legends|20.2 BBY]].</ref> culminated in an [[Bombardment of Humbarine/Legends|orbital bombardment]] that [[Death/Legends|depopulated]] the planet and [[Temperature/Legends|melted]] its crust.<ref name="CSWE InvisibleHand" /> Due to the losses suffered in the Humbarine sector, Senator Breemu found her [[Politics/Legends|political]] influence waning,<ref name="DB Breemu" /> and the Republic eventually abandoned the sector as a lost cause.<ref name="DB Oicunn" />

==Locations==
[[File:Humbarine.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Humbarine sector's capital was the city-world of the same name.]]
The Humbarine sector contained several industrious<ref name="ChroniclesPrequels">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> [[Factory world/Legends|manufacturing planets]], and the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-planet]] Humbarine, located in the system of the same name,<ref name="TEA" /> served as its capital.<ref name="CSWE Humbarine" /> Humbarine was [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sleeper ship/Legends|colonization arks]] from the planet [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] of the nearby [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuat system]]. In turn, Humbarine eventually established colony worlds of its own and eventually became one of the [[Core Founder/Legends|founding members]] of the Galactic Republic<ref name="TEA" /> upon that government's [[Galactic Constitution Conference|establishment]] in [[25,053 BBY]].<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] of [[3996 BBY]], Republic [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval forces]] passed through the Humbarine system on their way to [[Battle of Onderon (Great Sith War)|engage]] the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Japrael system/Legends|Japrael system]]. Humbarine was subjected to a devastating [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] during the Clone Wars,<ref name="TEA" /> and its system was situated within the territory of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after its [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|military forces]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] passed through the Humbarine system on their way to [[Battle of Fondor|engage]] the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaders]] at the [[Fondor system/Legends|Fondor system]] of the Colonies. [[28 ABY/Legends|Three years]] later, the New Republic forces once again transited the system when preparing for a [[Battle of Ebaq|confrontation]] with the Yuuzhan Vong in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core's]] [[Treskov system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Humbarine sector was first mentioned in the [[2002]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]'' by [[Curtis Saxton]].<ref name="AotCICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> The planet Humbarine, and therefore the sector, first appeared in the non-[[canon]]ical [[2009]] [[Star Wars video games|mobile game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Mind Tricks]]'',<ref name="JMT">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Mind Tricks]]''</ref> and on [[August 18]], 2009,<ref name="Penguin">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> the reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] coined the alternative name "Humbarine Rule" for the sector and placed its Humbarine system in grid square M-10.<ref name="TEA" />
